verdict.rationale: The SDK axis fairly applies, since the IRS runs machine channels (MeF XML transmission and IRIS A2A). However, the evidence shows no official SDK or client library. The closest item is a SOAP A2A toolkit of WSDLs and schema packages, distributed through a registration-gated portal or by email request. These are interface definitions, developer building blocks rather than an official SDK, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: the SOAP A2A toolkit (containing the WSDLs) is provided on email request
